2036.name: Game Wizard Neptune
2036.content:
## PATENT PENDING

The Game Wizard Neptune Upright Cabinet is Australia's first multi-platform arcade system with a patented design, and the most advanced arcade machine in the marketplace. The Game Wizard Neptune is compatible with a variety of gaming devices including Xbox 360, Xbox One, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4 and PC. With the Game Wizard Neptune Upright Cabinet you can switch between the gaming systems with ease, and changing a game can be as simple as changing a disc.



## See the Game Wizard Neptune in Action

The Game Wizard Neptune is user friendly and modular in design. Players can switch between the gaming systems with ease and changing a game can be as simple as changing a disc or using your online gaming libraries.



## Features of the Game Wizard Neptune

Play by Joystick, Controller and More

Unlimited Gaming

Supports all Consoles

Jukebox Sound Including Subwoofer

Game Wizard Neptune allows players to choose how they want to play all their favourite games - using the specially designed arcade control panel with joystick, push button and trackball controls, or by connecting an external console hand controller or keyboard and mouse using the USB ports built into the machine.

Game Wizard Neptune supports PlayStation, XBOX, and PC. For further gaming options connect to Steam, XBOX Live, PlayStation Network and Origin using personal accounts and Ethernet connection. This is all plug and play, no extra modifications or wiring necessary.

Users can connect their XBOX 360, XBOX One, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, Raspberry Pi and more to the Game Wizard Neptune and play their favourite video games on a commercial grade arcade machine. Players can also connect their console hand controller to the USB ports built into the machine to play a wider variety of games. The machine will be continually upgraded and owners will receive firmware updates to upgrade the machine's compatibility to current consoles.

The Game Wizard Neptune can double as a video jukebox, further enhanced by the jukebox quality speakers and subwoofer built into the cabinet.
